+"""Add business_id, industry, date_onboarded, client_status, first_lead_id, first_inquiry_id to clients.
+
+Revision ID: 0011_client_business_id
+Revises: 0015_named_constraints
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.client import Client
+
+
+revision = "0011_client_business_id"
+down_revision = "0015_named_constraints"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    # Add new columns
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_lead_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_inquiry_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+
+    # Create indexes
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])
+
+    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
+    conn = op.get_bind()
+    # Get all existing clients
+    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()
+    for client_id, created_at in existing_clients:
+        # Extract year from created_at or use current year
+        year = created_at.year if created_at else 2026
+        # Generate business_id for each client
+        business_id = next_business_id(conn, "CLT", year)
+        conn.execute(
+            sa.update(Client)
+            .where(Client.id == client_id)
+            .values(business_id=business_id)
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_inquiry_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_lead_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "client_status")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "date_onboarded")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "industry")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "business_id")

+import uuid
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.admin_process import (
+    AdminProcessCreate,
+    AdminProcessListResponse,
+    AdminProcessRead,
+    AdminProcessUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.admin_process_service import process_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin-processes", tags=["admin-processes"])
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=AdminProcessListResponse)
+def list_processes(
+    _: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+    q: str | None = None,
+) -> AdminProcessListResponse:
+    items, total, page, page_size = process_service.list_processes_service(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q
+    )
+    return AdminProcessListResponse(
+        items=[AdminProcessRead.model_validate(p) for p in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=AdminProcessRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_process(
+    body: AdminProcessCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+) -> AdminProcessRead:
+    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+    try:
+        process = process_service.create_process_service(db, body, current_user.id)
+        return AdminProcessRead.model_validate(process)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.drn import DocType, DocumentNature, DRNStatus, IntendedUser
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.drn import (
+    DRNListResponse,
+    DRNRead,
+    DRNUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services import drn_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["drn"])
+
+
+@router.post("/drns", response_model=DRNRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_drn(
+    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
+    doc_type: str = Form(...),
+    date: str = Form(...),
+    associated_project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    associated_token_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    author_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    document_nature: str = Form(DocumentNature.INTERNAL.value),
+    intended_user: str = Form(IntendedUser.INTERNAL.value),
+    description: str = Form(...),
+    revision: str = Form("R0"),
+    status: str = Form(DRNStatus.DRAFT.value),
+    remarks: str | None = Form(None),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    if file and file.filename:
+        if len(file.file.read()) > drn_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+        file.file.seek(0)
+
+    try:
+        doc_type_enum = DocType(doc_type)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid doc_type. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocType)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        document_nature_enum = DocumentNature(document_nature)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid document_nature. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentNature)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        intended_user_enum = IntendedUser(intended_user)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid intended_user. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in IntendedUser)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = None
+    original_filename = None
+    if file and file.filename:
+        file_bytes = file.file.read()
+        original_filename = file.filename
+
+    project_id = uuid.UUID(associated_project_id) if associated_project_id else None
+    token_id = uuid.UUID(associated_token_id) if associated_token_id else None
+    author_uuid = uuid.UUID(author_id) if author_id else current_user.id
+
+    drn = drn_service.create_drn(
+        db=db,
+        doc_type=doc_type_enum.value,
+        date=datetime.fromisoformat(date),
+        associated_project_id=project_id,
+        associated_token_id=token_id,
+        author_id=author_uuid,
+        document_nature=document_nature_enum.value,
+        intended_user=intended_user_enum.value,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status_enum.value,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_bytes=file_bytes,
+        original_filename=original_filename,
+    )
+
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns", response_model=DRNListResponse)
+def list_drns(
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    project_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    token_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    doc_type: str | None = Query(None),
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    project_uuid = uuid.UUID(project_id) if project_id else None
+    token_uuid = uuid.UUID(token_id) if token_id else None
+
+    items, total = drn_service.list_drns(
+        db,
+        project_id=project_uuid,
+        token_id=token_uuid,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        status=status,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+    return DRNListResponse(
+        items=[DRNRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def get_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.patch("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def update_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: DRNUpdate,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.update_drn(db, drn_id, **update_data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.delete("/drns/{drn_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    success = drn_service.delete_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+
+
+@router.post("/drns/{drn_id}/transition-status", response_model=DRNRead)
+def transition_status(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str = Form(...),
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    drn = drn_service.transition_status(db, drn_id, status_enum.value)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}/download")
+def download_file(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    file_path = drn_service.get_file_path(db, drn_id)
+    if not file_path:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found")
+
+    path = Path(file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type="application/octet-stream",
+        filename=f"drn_{drn_id}.file",
+    )

+"""Base CRUD service helper for HR bundle modules.
+
+Provides common CRUD operations for HR-related entities.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class BaseCRUDService(Generic[T]):
+    """Base CRUD service for HR entities."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repo_module):
+        self.repo = repo_module
+
+    def list_items(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+        q: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[T], int, int, int]:
+        """List items with pagination and search."""
+        items, total = self.repo.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def get_item(self, db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> T | None:
+        """Get item by ID."""
+        return self.repo.get_by_id(db, item_id)
+
+    def create_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T:
+        """Create item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.repo.create(db, **kwargs)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.create",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            after_json={
+                "id": str(item.id),
+                **self._get_audit_fields(item),
+            },
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def update_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T | None:
+        """Update item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return None
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if hasattr(item, key):
+                setattr(item, key, value)
+
+        self.repo.update(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.update",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def delete_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Delete item (soft delete) with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return False
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        self.repo.soft_delete(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.delete",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return True
+
+    def _get_entity_type(self) -> str:
+        """Get entity type for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return "item"
+
+    def _get_audit_fields(self, item: T) -> dict:
+        """Get fields for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return {"id": str(item.id)}

+"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.
+
+Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Save a file for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
+        original_name: Original filename
+        file_bytes: File content as bytes
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
+    """
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Get the full path for a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        Full file path or None if not found
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    return str(path) if path.exists() else None
+
+
+def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
+    """Delete a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    if path.exists():
+        path.unlink()
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
+    """List all files for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+
+    Returns:
+        List of filenames
+    """
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    if not d.exists():
+        return []
+
+    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

+import uuid
+from datetime import date

+
+from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
+    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()
+
+
+def list_time_logs(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    employee_id: str | None = None,
+    work_type: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+    end_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
+    query = db.query(TimeLog)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
+        )
+
+    if employee_id:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
+
+    if work_type:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
+
+    if start_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)
+
+    if end_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
+    db.add(time_log)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        setattr(time_log, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
+    db.delete(time_log)
+    db.commit()

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def create_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    doc_type: str,
+    date: datetime,
+    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    document_nature: str = "Internal",
+    intended_user: str = "Internal",
+    description: str = "",
+    revision: str = "R0",
+    status: str = "Draft",
+    remarks: str | None = None,
+    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
+    original_filename: str | None = None,
+) -> DRN:
+    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)
+
+    file_path = None
+    if file_bytes and original_filename:
+        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)
+
+    drn = DRN(
+        drn_code=drn_code,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        date=date,
+        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
+        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
+        author_id=author_id,
+        document_nature=document_nature,
+        intended_user=intended_user,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_path=file_path,
+    )
+    db.add(drn)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def list_drns(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
+    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)
+
+    if project_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
+    if token_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
+    if doc_type:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
+    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def update_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    for key, value in kwargs.items():
+        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(drn, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return False
+
+    drn.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    drn.status = new_status
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+    return drn.file_path

+def can_transition_status(from_status: str, to_status: str) -> bool:
+    allowed_transitions = {
+        TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS: {
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CLOSED: {
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW: {
+            TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
+    }
+
+    return to_status in allowed_transitions.get(from_status, set())
+
+
+def create_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_date: datetime,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    token_type: str,
+    description: Optional[str] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    tokens_used: Optional[Decimal] = None,
+    swa_team_lead: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    project_owner: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    client_employee_name: Optional[str] = None,
+    client_employee_email: Optional[str] = None,
+    notes: Optional[str] = None,
+    created_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token:
+    current_year = datetime.utcnow().year
+
+    token = Token(
+        token_date=token_date,
+        agreement_id=agreement_id,
+        token_type=token_type,
+        description=description,
+        token_status=token_status or TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
+        tokens_used=tokens_used,
+        swa_team_lead=swa_team_lead,
+        project_owner=project_owner,
+        client_employee_name=client_employee_name,
+        client_employee_email=client_employee_email,
+        notes=notes,
+    )
+
+    db.add(token)
+    db.flush()
+
+    token.token_id = next_business_id(db, "TKN", current_year)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.create",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=created_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "agreement_id": str(agreement_id),
+            "token_type": token_type,
+            "token_status": token.token_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(tokens_used) if tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+

+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Token], int]:
+    query = db.query(Token)
+
+    if agreement_id:
+        query = query.filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id)
+
+    if token_status:
+        query = query.filter(Token.token_status == token_status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def update_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: dict,
+    updated_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    for key, value in update_data.items():
+        if hasattr(token, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(token, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    if old_status != token.token_status:
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="token.status_transition",
+            entity_type="token",
+            entity_id=token.id,
+            user_id=updated_by,
+            after_json={
+                "token_id": token.token_id,
+                "from_status": old_status,
+                "to_status": token.token_status,
+            },
+        )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def delete_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    deleted_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    token_status = token.token_status
+    if token_status not in {TokenStatus.CANCELLED, TokenStatus.CLOSED}:
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Cannot delete token with status '{token_status}'. "
+            "Only 'Cancelled' or 'Closed' tokens can be deleted."
+        )
+
+    db.delete(token)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.delete",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token_id,
+        user_id=deleted_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "token_status": token_status,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_token_status(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    transitioned_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    if not can_transition_status(token.token_status, new_status):
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Invalid status transition from '{token.token_status}' to '{new_status}'"
+        )
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    token.token_status = new_status
+
+    if new_status == TokenStatus.CLOSED and token.tokens_used:
+        agreement = (
+            db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+            .filter(ServiceAgreement.id == token.agreement_id)
+            .first()
+        )
+        if agreement:
+            agreement.total_tokens = (
+                (agreement.total_tokens or 0) + float(token.tokens_used)
+            )
+            db.commit()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.status_transition",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=transitioned_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "from_status": old_status,
+            "to_status": new_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(token.tokens_used) if token.tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_tokens_by_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Token]:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id).all()

def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def test_client_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client):
    """Test that business_id is auto-generated when not provided."""
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "TestClient",
        "code": "TC-AUTO-001",
        "primary_email": "tc-auto@example.com",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "business_id" in body
    assert body["business_id"].startswith("SWA-2026-CLT-")
    assert len(body["business_id"]) == 18  # SWA-YYYY-CLT-NNN


async def test_client_business_id_manual_override(authed_admin_client):

    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "TestClientManual",
        "code": "TC-MANUAL-001",
        "primary_email": "tc-manual@example.com",
        "business_id": "SWA-2025-CLT-999",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["business_id"] == "SWA-2025-CLT-999"


async def test_client_industry_filter(authed_admin_client):
    """Test filtering clients by industry."""
    # Create clients with different industries
    await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "PharmaClient",
        "code": "PHARMA-001",
        "primary_email": "pharma@example.com",
        "industry": "Pharma",
    })

        "name": "TechClient",
        "code": "TECH-001",
        "primary_email": "tech@example.com",
        "industry": "Technology",

    body = r.json()

    assert body["items"][0]["industry"] == "Pharma"

    state: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    pincode: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=True)
    country: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=False, default="India")
    gst_number: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    primary_email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), nullable=False)
    primary_phone: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    first_inquiry_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    if status:
        query = query.filter(Client.client_status == status)

    if industry:
        query = query.filter(Client.industry == industry)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
    business_id: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
    date_onboarded: date | None = None,
    client_status: str = "Active",
    first_lead_id: str | None = None,
    first_inquiry_id: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
        business_id=business_id,
        industry=industry,
        date_onboarded=date_onboarded,
        client_status=client_status,
        first_lead_id=first_lead_id,
        first_inquiry_id=first_inquiry_id,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

    # Add new columns
    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))

    # Create indexes
    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])

    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
    conn = op.get_bind()
    # Get all existing clients
    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def test_client_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client):
    """Test that business_id is auto-generated when not provided."""
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "TestClient",
        "code": "TC-AUTO-001",
        "primary_email": "tc-auto@example.com",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "business_id" in body
    assert body["business_id"].startswith("SWA-2026-CLT-")
    assert len(body["business_id"]) == 18  # SWA-YYYY-CLT-NNN


async def test_client_business_id_manual_override(authed_admin_client):
    """Test that manual business_id is respected when provided."""
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "TestClientManual",
        "code": "TC-MANUAL-001",
        "primary_email": "tc-manual@example.com",
        "business_id": "SWA-2025-CLT-999",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["business_id"] == "SWA-2025-CLT-999"


async def test_client_industry_filter(authed_admin_client):
    """Test filtering clients by industry."""
    # Create clients with different industries
    await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "PharmaClient",
        "code": "PHARMA-001",
        "primary_email": "pharma@example.com",
        "industry": "Pharma",
    })

    await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "TechClient",
        "code": "TECH-001",
        "primary_email": "tech@example.com",
        "industry": "Technology",
    })

    # Test filter by Pharma
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/clients?industry=Pharma")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body["items"]) == 1
    assert body["items"][0]["industry"] == "Pharma"


async def test_client_status_filter(authed_admin_client):
    """Test filtering clients by status."""
    # Create clients with different statuses
    await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "ActiveClient",
        "code": "ACTIVE-001",
        "primary_email": "active@example.com",
        "client_status": "Active",
    })

    await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "DormantClient",
        "code": "DORMANT-001",
        "primary_email": "dormant@example.com",
        "client_status": "Dormant",
    })

    # Test filter by Dormant
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/clients?status=Dormant")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body["items"]) == 1
    assert body["items"][0]["client_status"] == "Dormant"


async def test_existing_clients_queryable(authed_admin_client):
    """Test that existing clients (from wave-2 tests) are still queryable."""
    # Create a client with all new fields
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "ExistingClient",
        "code": "EXISTING-001",
        "primary_email": "existing@example.com",
        "business_id": "SWA-2025-CLT-001",
        "industry": "Manufacturing",
        "date_onboarded": "2025-01-15",
        "client_status": "Active",
        "first_lead_id": "LEAD-001",
        "first_inquiry_id": "INQ-001",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["business_id"] == "SWA-2025-CLT-001"
    assert body["industry"] == "Manufacturing"
    assert body["client_status"] == "Active"
    assert body["first_lead_id"] == "LEAD-001"
    assert body["first_inquiry_id"] == "INQ-001"


async def test_client_fields_in_response(authed_admin_client):
    """Test that all new fields are present in client response."""
    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/clients", json={
        "name": "FullClient",
        "code": "FULL-001",
        "primary_email": "full@example.com",
        "business_id": "SWA-2025-CLT-500",
        "industry": "Healthcare",
        "date_onboarded": "2025-03-10",
        "client_status": "Active",
        "first_lead_id": "LEAD-500",
        "first_inquiry_id": "INQ-500",
    })
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "business_id" in body
    assert "industry" in body
    assert "date_onboarded" in body
    assert "client_status" in body
    assert "first_lead_id" in body
    assert "first_inquiry_id" in body
    assert body["business_id"] == "SWA-2025-CLT-500"
    assert body["industry"] == "Healthcare"
    assert body["client_status"] == "Active"
    assert body["first_lead_id"] == "LEAD-500"
    assert body["first_inquiry_id"] == "INQ-500"

import pytest
from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Speed up tests by lowering bcrypt work factor (production stays at 12)
import bcrypt as _bcrypt
_original_gensalt = _bcrypt.gensalt

def _fast_gensalt(rounds=None, prefix=None):
    return _original_gensalt(rounds=4, prefix=prefix)

_bcrypt.gensalt = _fast_gensalt

from src.backend.core.security import hash_password
from src.backend.db.base import Base
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.main import app
import src.backend.models  # noqa: F401 - registers all models with Base.metadata
from src.backend.models.user import User

TEST_DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test"

engine = create_engine(TEST_DATABASE_URL, pool_pre_ping=True, future=True)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(
    autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False
)


def _reset_tables():
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        existing = {r[0] for r in result}
        # sorted_tables is in dependency order (parents first); delete children first
        tables = [t.name for t in Base.metadata.sorted_tables if t.name in existing]
        # Use DELETE instead of TRUNCATE to avoid AccessExclusiveLock deadlocks
        # against idle connections from the SQLAlchemy pool.
        for tbl in reversed(tables):
            conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {tbl}"))
        # Restart sequences
        if tables:
            seq_result = conn.execute(text(
                "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relkind = 'S' AND relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace"
            ))
            for row in seq_result:
                conn.execute(text(f"ALTER SEQUENCE {row[0]} RESTART WITH 1"))
        conn.commit()


@pytest.fixture(scope="session", autouse=True)
def setup_test_db():
    # Dispose pool to kill any leftover connections from previous runs
    engine.dispose()
    Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine, checkfirst=True)
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public'"))
        created = [r[0] for r in result]
        print(f"[setup_test_db] Created tables: {created}")
    yield
    # Just dispose the pool; don't drop tables to avoid deadlocks with pooled connections
    engine.dispose()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
def db_session():
    _reset_tables()
    session = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield session
    finally:
        session.close()


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client():
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac


@pytest.fixture(scope="function")
async def client_with_db(db_session):
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = lambda: db_session
    async with AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test") as ac:
        yield ac
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
